programme.title: Mood = Indie
programme.desc: A twist of indie
programme.series-desc:
The story begins with Shirō Kido's reunion with a former classmate, Rio Kijima, at a college teacher's funeral. In the past, when they were students, Kijima used to show talent as a novelist, even earning a big prize. Kido was jealous of Kijima's success, but after reading his works he became aware of his lack of talent and gave up writing novels and became an editor of erotic novels.
However, after reuniting it became clear to Kido that Kijima was stuck; facing a wall. He had used up all his talent. With Kido also being in a lost state, he offers Kijima the opportunity to write pornographic novels. With the intense eroticism and closeness, both men open up and feed into their desire. As their lust grows, so does their toxic craving.
The two become a relationship beyond the line while a mixture of emotions are drawn from the suffering Kijima.

programme.series-desc:
Songs of Praise is a BBC Television religious programme based around Christian hymns which began in October 1961. It is the most-watched British religious television programme.
The first edition was broadcast from the Tabernacle Baptist Church in Cardiff, and the series is the longest-running of its kind on television anywhere in the world.

programme.desc: Takashi Sorimachi stars as Satoru Tachibana, an advertising firm employee slaving away under a younger boss for a meager salary. One day, he desperately enters a lottery, trying to make enough money to pay for his child support, but his sense of self-disgust kicks in. However, his curiosity gets the better of him, and he later discovers that the ticket is a winner, turning him into a millionaire overnight. --Tokyograph

programme.series-desc:
From major roadside drink-driving operations and mobile breath testing, to high-speed pursuits and drivers under the influence of drugs, Booze Patrol Australia captures all the drama and danger that police face every day in their relentless campaign against drink driving.
See the police in action as they pull over some very lively characters including a grandmother who claims she never drinks, despite alcohol being detected, and a plumber whose pregnant wife is waiting for him at home - will a couple of beers after work on the way home land him in hot water?
We also meet a new driver who stopped drinking at midnight and is on his way to the beach for the day eleven hours later ? but is he still over the limit? Then there's the driver of the Toyota who appeared to pull up short of a police stop. Is he really an innocent drivert?
As well as covering traffic operations Booze Patrol Australia also heads out to sea with the NSW Water Police who patrol the waterways where the blood alcohol limit is the same as on the road.

Rewind is a Canadian television news series, which aired overnights on CP24. The series repeated past newscasts from Citytv Toronto.
Citytv and CP24 were owned by CHUM Limited until July 2007, when CP24 and the rest of the CHUM Limited properties were sold to CTVglobemedia, while the Citytv stations were sold to Rogers Media. However, the series continued to air on CP24 for one more year, and was cancelled in September 2008.

We also meet a new driver who stopped drinking at midnight and is on his way to the beach for the day eleven hours later ? but is he still over the limit? Then there's the driver of the Toyota who appeared to pull up short of a police stop. Is he really an innocent drivert?

For the day-to-day work, he's backed up by a group of talented, but not exactly mainstream, characters. And to succeed as a team, they all have to find the proverbial diamonds in the rough, chase down deals, and add value to what others throw away--it's not work, it's the hustle.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: Brought together by a bike build, Junior and Senior open up. OCC starts for Wildgame Innovations and PJD unveils a five-wheeled trike for Loopster.
programme.series-desc: Paul Teutul, Sr. and his son Paul Teutul, Jr. manufacture custom chopper-style motorcycles.

programme.title: Rugged Justice
programme.desc: Sgt. Jewell arrests a father and son squatting in the desert. Sgt. Maurstad searches for a criminal. The Bear Dog Unit releases an orphan bear.
programme.series-desc: Follows WSDFW Law Enforcement Program as they police the Evergreen State's unforgiving mountain terrains, twisted rain forest back roads and densely populated coastal areas. Each day brings new challenges and extreme danger.

programme.title: Last Chance Garage
programme.desc: Tony takes on a botched Scout nightmare with wiring issues. Another client's Camaro faces roof damage that needs immediate attention.
programme.series-desc: Specialty car restoration mistakes are much more common than you'd think, and each episode of LAST CHANCE GARAGE features a car with a horrifying backstory: multiple shops, years lost, and tens of thousands of dollars in sunk costs. On the flip side of that struggle, audiences will see the customer and learn about their unique - and often deeply personal - connection to their car.

programme.title: Swamp Loggers
programme.desc: As Goodson's All-Terrain winds down on one tract and prepares to move to another, Bobby's stress level rises when a permit snag threatens the move.
programme.series-desc: Swamp Loggers is an American reality television series on the Discovery Channel that follows the crew of Goodson's All Terrain Logging as they log the swamps of North Carolina.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: The team head to the Great Smoky Mountains after a reported Sasquatch sighting. Once there they enlist a professional hog caller to try and lure one out.
programme.series-desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Research Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission - to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Ekstensive customizes a '23 Mustang for a world-record donut attempt. The fabricators also create a modern setup for an old-school '49 Ford truck.
programme.series-desc: Specializing in one-of-a-kind custom builds, Bill Carlton and the crew of Houston's Ekstensive Metal Works deal with rowdy customers, challenging projects and tight timelines while working on everything from muscle cars to monster trucks.

programme.title: Texas Metal: Loud And Lifted
programme.desc: Daniel's creativity is tested turning a four-door 2006 GMC Sierra truck into their baddest off-road truck yet. Meanwhile, Mod Mafia tricks out a 2001 Hummer H1.
programme.series-desc: Texas is a mecca for truck customization, an uber-diverse metal cranking mash of everything from trophy-winning show trucks to drop it down lowriders. While Bill Carlton, host of TEXAS METAL, is still the reigning champion in the Lone Star State's custom truck world, TEXAS METAL'S LOUD AND LIFTED has been super-sized with three of the most talented, up-and-coming custom auto garages in the state: Wide Open Garage, Mod Mafia, and 1 Way Diesel Performance.

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Jane heads to the Arctic Circle hoping to bag a caribou before winter. Meanwhile, Otto, Eivin, Charlotte and August wrap up the season's final cattle drive.
programme.series-desc: Centers on the Kilcher family and their community outside Homer, Alaska. Begun by patriarch Yule Kilcher who immigrated from Europe during WWII, and currently led by his sons, Otto and Atz Kilcher (singer Jewel's father) the family have lived on their land for four generations. programme.desc: The Northwestern loses steering when a bald eagle lays claim to its mast. Josh and Casey place a risky bet on hard-to-find quota, while casualties mount on the Patty Lee.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: Autumn continues in the bush as the Last Alaskans settle into wilderness solitude. Battling loneliness, Bob Harte welcomes a visitor to his cabin.
programme.series-desc: In 1980, the U.S. government banned new human occupation in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge in Alaska, a protected area, home to thousands of native animals and pristine terrain spanning roughly the size of South Carolina. Currently, only a handful of families spread across seven permitted cabins are allowed to remain in the refuge. Within less than 100 years, all remaining permits will reach expiration, and there will be no human presence left.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Mike Brewer discovers a Mini Mark 1, in Wales. Ace mechanic Marc 'Elvis' Priestley knows making radical changes to such a historic car will enrage Mini enthusiasts.
programme.series-desc: Experienced car dealer Mike Brewer is joined by multi-talented mechanics in a monumental motoring mission: to find and restore iconic cars to later sell for a profit at their LA-based shop. In the series, Mike has the challenging job of finding vehicles that have money-making potential. He then hands them over to a mechanic, who tackles everything from bare metal re-sprays to gearbox swaps to bring them back to their former glory.

programme.desc: Takashi Sorimachi stars as Satoru Tachibana, an advertising firm employee slaving away under a younger boss for a meager salary. programme.desc: Ari, Caitlin, Myles, and Precious experience the joy of a transgender pregnancy when Ari and Myles, the men in their relationships, become pregnant. The couples must then conquer unique...
programme.series-desc: Antique restorer Sang Qian (Claire Sanders), misunderstanding that her husband Jin Changyu (Charles King) still harbors feelings for his unrequited love, files for divorce in despair. However, she unexpectedly discovers she's pregnant, but her doctor tells her she can't have an abortion due to health reasons. Jin Changyu uses this opportunity to offer two choices: cancel the divorce or get a divorce certificate, but they must live together during the pregnancy. Sang Qian, seeking freedom, chooses the latter, beginning a post-divorce "roommate" relationship. During their cohabitation, her workaholic ex-husband transforms into a clingy figure, displaying his affection. Sang Qian gradually realizes that their relationship is built on layers of misunderstanding, ultimately resolving their issues and reconciling.

programme.title: Sex Sent Me To The ER
programme.desc: A two-hour orgasm sends a woman to the ER, a couple choose an unlikely romantic spot that leads to injury, and a naked man takes a suspicious fall.
programme.series-desc: Sex in a tree? A quickie in the closet? Laundry room relations? These are just a few of the out-of-the-ordinary places where amorous adventurers go to get intimate with their other halves. But few people expect to land themselves in the emergency room as a result! Brought to life for Discovery Fit & Health by GRB Entertainment, the production company behind the hit show UNTOLD STORIES OF THE ER, this all-new series documents the real-life and often hilarious stories of what happens when a little action leads to a medical crisis. Retold by emergency room physicians and the actual couples who, in the heat of the moment, got themselves into a fix and needed a doctor to fix it, this series illustrates how loving couples cope when sex goes outrageously wrong.

The show's theme was that many inventions which are thought to be modern have ancient roots or in some cases may have been lost and then reinvented. The program was a follow-up to a special originally broadcast in 2005 which focused on technologies from the Ancient Roman era such as the Antikythera mechanism and inventors such as Heron of Alexandria. Ancient Discoveries was made for The History Channel by Wild Dream Films based in Cardiff in the UK. Much of the filming was done on location across the world. The series used contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts, computer generated reconstructions and dramatized reconstructions along with experiments and tests on reconstructed artifacts.

programme.series-desc:
Ancient Discoveries was a television series that premiered on December 21, 2003, on The History Channel. The program focused on ancient technologies. The show's theme was that many inventions which are thought to be modern have ancient roots or in some cases may have been lost and then reinvented. The program was a follow-up to a special originally broadcast in 2005 which focused on technologies from the Ancient Roman era such as the Antikythera mechanism and inventors such as Heron of Alexandria. Episodes of the regular series expanded to cover other areas such as Egypt, China and East Asia, and the Islamic world.
Ancient Discoveries was made for The History Channel by Wild Dream Films based in Cardiff in the UK. Much of the filming was done on location across the world. The series used contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts, computer generated reconstructions and dramatized reconstructions along with experiments and tests on reconstructed artifacts.

programme.series-desc: The year is 1899. The young girl Marie Jensen lives at an orphanage with her two younger siblings Karl and Sofie. Their father is a sailor and has not been home for years. He was last seen in Norway but everybody is convinced he was lost at sea – except Marie. One morning the beautiful freighter ‘Hope’ comes to town with Skipper Andersen and his wife Mrs. Agnete on board. To Marie’s distress, they adopt Karl and Sofie, and Marie now faces being left alone. But quickly she comes up with a plan. At night, she cuts her long hair and disguises herself as a boy, adopts the name of Martin and signs on as a deck boy on ‘’Hope’. The ship takes Marie and her siblings on an eventful journey from the coast of Denmark to Norway and Iceland. A journey full of secrets, friendship, love and adventure – all in the hope of finding her father and reuniting her family. 'Finding Home' is a story about a young girl’s fight to break free of the path that society has destined for her and instead becoming a strong and independent woman.

programme.desc: Summer is the most intense season in the Highlands of Scotland, but it is also the richest, with seas and mountains yielding their greatest bounty.
programme.series-desc: In the North of Scotland, far from bustling cities and gentle hills of the South, lies Europe's greatest wilderness – the Highlands of Scotland. Scoured by ice and weathered by storms, it may look bleak and lifeless, but wildlife is thriving in this unforgiving place, if you know where to look! In this stunning four-part series, narrated by Ewan McGregor, we meet ospreys, red squirrels, otters, dolphin and golden eagles – all struggling to turn adversity to their advantage and make a success of living in Scotland's living Wild Heart.

programme.series-desc: The year is 1899. The young girl Marie Jensen lives at an orphanage with her two younger siblings Karl and Sofie. Their father is a sailor and has not been home for years. He was last seen in Norway but everybody is convinced he was lost at sea – except Marie. One morning the beautiful freighter ‘Hope’ comes to town with Skipper Andersen and his wife Mrs. Agnete on board. To Marie’s distress, they adopt Karl and Sofie, and Marie now faces being left alone. But quickly she comes up with a plan. At night, she cuts her long hair and disguises herself as a boy, adopts the name of Martin and signs on as a deck boy on ‘’Hope’. The ship takes Marie and her siblings on an eventful journey from the coast of Denmark to Norway and Iceland. A journey full of secrets, friendship, love and adventure – all in the hope of finding her father and reuniting her family. 'Finding Home' is a story about a young girl’s fight to break free of the path that society has destined for her and instead becoming a strong and independent woman.

programme.title: Scotland's Wild Heart
programme.desc: Summer is the most intense season in the Highlands of Scotland, but it is also the richest, with seas and mountains yielding their greatest bounty.
programme.series-desc: In the North of Scotland, far from bustling cities and gentle hills of the South, lies Europe's greatest wilderness – the Highlands of Scotland. Scoured by ice and weathered by storms, it may look bleak and lifeless, but wildlife is thriving in this unforgiving place, if you know where to look! In this stunning four-part series, narrated by Ewan McGregor, we meet ospreys, red squirrels, otters, dolphin and golden eagles – all struggling to turn adversity to their advantage and make a success of living in Scotland's living Wild Heart.

programme.title: The Programming of Life
programme.desc: A further examination of the theory of origins, and the chemical and biological theory of evolution, asking the difficult questions in order to reveal the truth about undirected natural processes

programme.title: Masterstroke
programme.desc: The painting 'The incredulity of Thomas' by Caravaggio, depicts the most notorious example of doubt in history. So why did Thomas have such doubts, and how did he resolve them?

programme.title: Live at Psalter Studio
programme.desc: Katie e Veau shares her inspiration for her song writing and creativity, and shares some of the music from her professional albums.

programme.title: Finding Home
programme.desc: Finding Home is in Manna Park, a church community of different ages, nationalities, and life experiences, who all love and support one another as they seek to live out God's awesome plan for them
programme.series-desc: The year is 1899. The young girl Marie Jensen lives at an orphanage with her two younger siblings Karl and Sofie. Their father is a sailor and has not been home for years. He was last seen in Norway but everybody is convinced he was lost at sea – except Marie. One morning the beautiful freighter ‘Hope’ comes to town with Skipper Andersen and his wife Mrs. Agnete on board. To Marie’s distress, they adopt Karl and Sofie, and Marie now faces being left alone. But quickly she comes up with a plan. At night, she cuts her long hair and disguises herself as a boy, adopts the name of Martin and signs on as a deck boy on ‘’Hope’. The ship takes Marie and her siblings on an eventful journey from the coast of Denmark to Norway and Iceland. A journey full of secrets, friendship, love and adventure – all in the hope of finding her father and reuniting her family. 'Finding Home' is a story about a young girl’s fight to break free of the path that society has destined for her and instead becoming a strong and independent woman.
